preconditions: Pinned function-based SDK/compiler and complete reviewed dependency closure
Source and parameters fixed by revision; explicit seeds and declared input assets
stimulus: Type-check, transpile, execute, normalize, validate and export separately
Build twice with identical locked inputs; change each dependency class and check cache invalidation
Submit bad types, JS closures, nonfinite data, missing references and unsupported instructions

Run the same valid/invalid parameter corpus through Zod, exported JSON Schema and the actual native validator: unknown fields, coercion, nulls, nonfinite values, safe-integer boundaries, tagged unions, local references, nesting and size limits
acceptance: Valid source produces real project-owned meshes and a complete package with source maps
Every bad input fails at the owning stage with stable source-aware diagnostics and no published partial output
Equal bytes are demonstrated only within the recorded build compatibility class; other targets retain exact hashes and explicit differences
Static geometry is generated once during build; no per-frame generator runs
All three parameter validators agree on every corpus case without silent coercion, key removal, widening or unsupported schema keywords; unrepresentable schemas reject during export
artifacts: shared parameter/schema parity corpus and per-validator outcomes

preconditions: Host-specific OS sandbox or disposable VM and independent supervisor implemented
Harness, SDK and toolchain are outside writable worker mounts; offline dependency closure ready
stimulus: Attempt host files/credentials, inherited descriptors, sockets, loopback/internet, subprocess escape and protected harness writes from source and package hooks
Attempt path traversal, symlink/hardlink escape, output swap, cache poisoning, fork/memory/disk/log exhaustion
Cancel or watchdog a stuck worker and retry; start on a host without isolation
acceptance: No denied host data or control authority is read, modified or exfiltrated; no descendant survives termination
All declared CPU/memory/process/file/output/log/wall limits are enforced, including native binaries and WASM
Denied operations and exhaustion produce bounded structured terminal reports; previous working package remains exact
Missing isolation rejects untrusted builds with isolation_unavailable; no plain-Node fallback
Dependency acquisition and reviewed recipe execution are separate from offline builds

preconditions: Actual native staged loader and compiled package format implemented
Previously valid session/package kept for rollback comparison
stimulus: Load generated GLBs plus world/collision/event manifests without Node, browser, editor or GPU in logical mode
Repeat with native renderer enabled
Corrupt hashes, bounds, paths, buffer strides/indices, resource references, spawns, schema versions, material/extension IDs and local original-asset identities
acceptance: Both modes initialize the same entities, collision and serializable event state through actual runtime services
Every corrupt or unsupported package rejects atomically without damaging the previous session or local original store
Rendering assets do not define collision/gameplay through arbitrary glTF extras
Native loader does bounded decoding and validation; parse success alone does not admit a package

preconditions: Project-owned solid/surface/arbitrary/imported adapters and documented coordinate/collision conversions
Geometry cases define expected topology, material regions and traversal boundaries
stimulus: Generate primitives, boolean opening, extrusion/revolution and an open indexed surface; inspect normalized vertices/triangles
Apply transforms including nonuniform and negative scale and test the documented reject/correction policy
Inject bad indices, NaN, degenerate/open boolean operands, over-budget topology and invalid dimensions
Traverse door/arch clearances from both sides and attempt collision through adjacent walls
acceptance: Real geometry carries consistent positions/indices/normals/UVs/materials/bounds and source attribution
Scale, handedness, winding, normals and native collision-unit precision pass explicit boundary fixtures
Open/custom/imported meshes avoid inappropriate solid-kernel coercion; errors identify operands/source
Doorway collider preserves the opening and surrounding wall collision; a sealing box/hull fails
Build validity, actual traversal and native presentation results are reported separately; unused/unimplemented operations remain unsupported

preconditions: Function-based TypeScript SDK with box/door and pickup operations; no imported geometry
Canonical authored test entry uses normal native loaders
stimulus: Agent authors one generated wall with a doorway, interactive door and collectible
Build and load the exact output, approach the closed door, open it through ordinary interaction, cross and collect
acceptance: The SDK-to-native path works without engine C++ edits or GUI automation
Closed door blocks movement, open door permits traversal, and pickup is awarded by normal eligibility exactly once
Package runs with the authoring environment absent
artifacts: native ordered actions and state hashes

preconditions: Minimal native bridge passed; original authored fixtures licensed for distribution
Protected reachability and reward assertions fixed before generation
stimulus: Author two rooms, arched passage, stairs or an elevation change, a novel procedural object, NPC/dialogue and one-time reward using only source geometry
Run legal traversal, interaction and transition paths, including blocked approaches and repeated dialogue
acceptance: Every required environment/object mesh is generated from source, not copied from a prefab/model
The actual native player crosses the arch/elevation and reaches both rooms without teleport or corrective state writes
NPC dialogue and one-time reward use native state and preserve stable content IDs

preconditions: Two-room source-only variant retained independently
Redistributable external model and license/hash are recorded; original references require qualified local IDs
stimulus: Create a second variant mixing generated geometry with an imported model
Resolve a local original reference when qualified; remove/mismatch the required local asset
Inspect packaged files for extracted original content and unexpected dependencies
acceptance: Source-only and mixed paths both pass independently with explicit origin-specific decoding
Imported model preserves reviewed units, transforms and supported materials; it does not define arbitrary gameplay capabilities
Original references fail with actionable identity errors when unavailable and never embed private original bytes
Distributed package contains only permitted content and required notices

preconditions: An ordinary agent can discover documented capabilities, exact IDs, schemas and runnable examples
Protected scenario initialized with explicit recorded setup; controller has ordinary gameplay authority after setup
stimulus: Discover, author, build and complete the exact two-room package with direct native gameplay actions
Replay the same actions in stepped and unthrottled image-free modes; attach/drop a spectator
Repeat interactions, leave and re-enter, and use ordinary save/load
acceptance: Collision/clearance, interaction, transition and reward-once assertions pass without corrective debug
Equal authoritative state/event outcomes across time modes and spectator changes; no GUI/OS/SDL injection
Unimplemented/opaque resources and actions return explicit unsupported states
A protected assertion failure cannot be converted to pass by modifying harness/tests or applying setup after play begins

preconditions: Known failing blocked-arch source revision and unchanged protected traversal test
Failed runtime observations are source-correlated
stimulus: Run failing immutable package and report the actual blocked movement
Agent diagnoses the responsible component/parameter, makes a focused source repair, rebuilds and reruns identical tests
Request a further arch-widening revision, rebuild it and rerun the unchanged protected suite on the final immutable package
acceptance: Original failure is preserved with package/harness identity and terminal failed result
Repair changes authored source and resolves real native collision; no teleport, test weakening or engine C++ workaround
Widening preserves unrelated handwritten source, content and stable entity/anchor IDs
Final generated geometry and actual native collision clearance increase by the requested dimension, and protected gameplay tests pass on that final package
Diagnostics and targeted diff connect observed failure to the actual editable source span/operation
artifacts: failing, fixed and final widened package hashes
measured requested arch geometry and native clearance

preconditions: Shared CLI/editor transaction service with expected revision and idempotency IDs
Active test pinned to an immutable package and protected harness
stimulus: Race stale edits, retry transaction IDs, dry-run cross-file changes, undo and introduce a failing watched build
Change source while a test runs; restart preview after a successful publication
Attempt to replace hand-authored code from a generated manifest
acceptance: Edits commit all or none; stale requests reject, retries do not duplicate edits, dry-run is nonmutating and undo is revision-aware
The running test continues using its original package; failed builds preserve the prior published package
Source, package, session and snapshot identities stay distinct; preview restart invalidates affected snapshots explicitly
Arbitrary code is preserved; unsupported round-trip and unsafe incremental state migration are rejected

preconditions: Small closed native vocabulary for triggers, doors, dialogue, pickups, conditions and tick waits
Explicit serializable event progress and source mappings
stimulus: Save/restore and exact-snapshot/branch before, during and after interaction/reward tasks
Step/break at a source-correlated event and resume; cancel/re-enter waits
Repeat reward paths and restore at the grant boundary
acceptance: Native introspection exposes instruction/targets/waits/timeouts/cancellation/reward ownership
Continuation executes each eligible transition exactly once; reload/re-entry and duplicate input cannot duplicate rewards
Replay hashes/event history agree in stepped and unthrottled modes; no JavaScript closure or wall-time state is required
Ordinary save/load and privileged exact snapshots are reported distinctly

preconditions: Successful protected run of immutable package and reviewed redistribution inputs
Source and focused patch preserved separately from compiled outputs
stimulus: Install the prebuilt package in a clean native environment without authoring tools
Reproduce from source and locks in the qualified build environment
Inspect every package/source file and rerun delivered replay with exact identities
acceptance: Deliver source, focused diff, installable package and exact build/test/replay artifacts
No Node/browser/Qt/geometry kernel is needed during play; no private original assets or undeclared executable code is bundled
Run evidence records engine/compiler/package/harness versions, seeds, initial state, applied actions/ticks, coverage, assertions and terminal result
Optional native captures/audio record identities and remain separate from mandatory logical success; simulation time is not estimated human time

preconditions: Early bridge gates passed and Phase 7 deterministic Lua extension API implemented
Supported battle/quest capabilities declared without invented original semantics
stimulus: Agent authors/revises a small town or dungeon with branching quest, optional encounter, custom Lua and failure/retry paths
Test reference validity, analyzable graph reachability, gameplay, saves/rewind, rewards and presentation separately
Run multiple seeds/player policies for declared balance observations
acceptance: Legal native completion and failure/retry paths pass with source and stable IDs preserved
Lua tasks/errors/state participate in native introspection, permissions, snapshots and scheduler
No duplicated reward or lost quest progress after save/rewind/re-entry
Graph checks do not claim proof of arbitrary scripts or balance; seed/policy and human-time assumptions are reported

preconditions: Shared source/compiler/validation services and graphical editor clients implemented
Handwritten components and parameterized source with unrelated human edits
stimulus: Perform equivalent agent and graphical edits, build and test the resulting content
Exercise undo, revision conflicts and targeted edits to levels/cutscenes/battles/minigames
Round-trip supported parameter edits while retaining custom code
acceptance: Every content operation has the same headless semantic service and validation behavior
Graphical panels do not own private game/compiler contracts or silently flatten source into generated data
Unrelated custom code and stable IDs survive supported edits; arbitrary TypeScript round-trip remains explicitly unsupported
Each implemented content family remains natively playable, inspectable and testable without engine C++ rebuilds
